pageProps.title: A Story That Is Gone Now
pageProps.review: Sharply insighting gaslighting in the name of social order and the cold reality through the 'Unhappy Boy' and 'Armor City' in Choi Kyu-sok's work, sharing the pleasure of deep thinking and discussion.
pageProps.description: A story we need right now, overturning all existing fables
pageProps.content:
## Review This is a work that makes you think deeply. I was able to have many discussions and stories through this work in a book club.
The Unhappy Boy only realizes the angel's gaslighting at the last moment. The angel's whisper might be the gaslighting that this society is doing to us in the name of order.
Armor City seems to show a very realistic and hollow reality that cannot be solved.
I highly recommend this work because each story allows for deep thinking and discussion.
